home_the_future_of_private_finance: The Future of Private Finance
home_about_nethxeumjoin_community: About Nethxeum Join Community
home_nethxeum_ntu_is_a_decentralize: Nethxeum (NTU) is a decentralized, privacy-preserving cryptocurrency that combines the proven scarcity model of Bitcoin with the battle-tested cryptographic privacy of Monero. Founded by Rony Katie, it introduces a hard supply cap of 42,000,000 NTU, a Bitcoin-style halving schedule every 420,000 blocks, zero tail emission, and full transaction confidentiality enforced at the protocol level.
home_privacy_by_default: Privacy by Default
home_every_transaction_on_the_nethxeum: Every transaction on the Nethxeum network is private by default. Sender identity, recipient identity, and transaction amounts are all cryptographically concealed through Ring Signatures, RingCT, and Stealth Addresses. Privacy is not optional — it is mandatory.
home_sound_money: Sound Money
home_with_a_fixed_supply_of: With a fixed supply of 42 million NTU and no tail emission, Nethxeum implements true digital scarcity. The halving every 420,000 blocks creates a predictable, transparent monetary policy that anyone can verify and trust. No central authority can inflate the supply.
home_learn_more_about_nethxeum: Learn More About Nethxeum
home_view_full_documentatio: View Full Documentation
home_nethxeum_follows_a_bitcoin_inspired: Nethxeum follows a Bitcoin-inspired halving schedule. Every 420,000 blocks (~4 years), the block reward is cut in half. The total supply converges precisely to 42,000,000 NTU.
home_epoch_5_continuing_halvings_until: Epoch 5+ — Continuing halvings until 0 ~2,625,000+ NTU (100% at ~160 years)
home_zero_coins_pre_allocated_fair: Zero coins pre-allocated. Fair launch from block 0.
home_no_initial_coin_offering_no: No initial coin offering. No venture capital allocation.
home_no_percentage_of_block_rewards: No percentage of block rewards goes to developers.
home_nethxeum_inherits_monero_s_cryptogr: Nethxeum inherits Monero's cryptographic privacy stack — the most proven privacy technology in production cryptocurrency, tested for over a decade under adversarial conditions.
home_your_transaction_is_co_signed: Your transaction is co-signed alongside decoy outputs from the blockchain. An observer cannot determine which member of the ring is the actual sender. Minimum ring size enforced at protocol level.
home_ring_confidential_transactions_hide: Ring Confidential Transactions hide the value of every input and output using Pedersen Commitments. Bulletproofs provide compact range proofs. No transaction amount is visible to any third party.
home_each_transaction_generates_a_unique: Each transaction generates a unique one-time address. Your published address never appears on the blockchain. Multiple payments cannot be linked to the same recipient.
home_download_walletread_documentatio: Download Wallet Read Documentation

about_project_history: Project History
about_nethxeum_was_founded_byrony_katiew: Nethxeum was founded by Rony Katie with a vision to create the perfect synthesis of Bitcoin's monetary policy and Monero's privacy technology. The project began development in early 2025, forking the proven Monero v0.18.3.3 codebase.
about_the_genesis_block_was_mined: The genesis block was mined on May 31, 2026, marking the official launch of the Nethxeum mainnet. The genesis message encapsulates the project's ethos:
about_in_a_world_of_surveillance: "In a world of surveillance, privacy is not a crime, it is a right."
about_since_launch_nethxeum_has_grown: Since launch, Nethxeum has grown into an international community of privacy advocates, developers, and miners committed to preserving financial freedom.
about_mission_vision: Mission & Vision
about_mission_to_provide_accessible_priv: Mission: To provide accessible, private, and sound digital money that cannot be censored, inflated, or surveilled.
about_vision_a_world_where_financial: Vision: A world where financial privacy is a fundamental right, not a privilege. Where every individual can transact freely without fear of surveillance or discrimination.
about_we_believe_that_privacy_and: We believe that privacy and scarcity are not opposing forces — they are complementary properties that together create the foundation of truly free money.
about_core_principles: Core Principles
about_privacy_must_be_mandatory_not: Privacy must be mandatory, not optional. Every transaction is private — there is no "transparent mode" that could compromise users.
about_hard_capped_supply_predictable_emi: Hard-capped supply, predictable emission, no inflation. Monetary policy written in code, not subject to human manipulation.
about_no_premine_no_ico_no: No premine, no ICO, no developer tax. Everyone starts at zero and must mine to earn NTU.
about_asic_resistant_mining_ensures_broa: ASIC-resistant mining ensures broad participation. No entity should control the network.
about_all_code_is_mit_licensed: All code is MIT licensed and fully auditable. Security through transparency.
about_no_corporate_entity_controls_nethx: No corporate entity controls Nethxeum. Decisions are made through open community discussion and consensus.

faq_what_is_nethxeum: What is Nethxeum?
faq_nethxeum_ntu_is_a_privacy: Nethxeum (NTU) is a privacy-focused cryptocurrency that combines Bitcoin-like scarcity (42M hard cap, halving schedule) with Monero-grade privacy (ring signatures, RingCT, stealth addresses). It uses the RandomX proof-of-work algorithm for democratic, CPU-friendly mining.
faq_how_is_nethxeum_different_from: How is Nethxeum different from Bitcoin?
faq_while_bitcoin_offers_transparent_tra: While Bitcoin offers transparent transactions and a 21M supply cap, Nethxeum provides mandatory privacy for all transactions and a 42M supply cap. Nethxeum also uses RandomX for ASIC-resistant CPU mining, whereas Bitcoin mining is dominated by specialized ASIC hardware.
faq_how_is_nethxeum_different_from_1: How is Nethxeum different from Monero?
faq_monero_has_unlimited_supply_with: Monero has unlimited supply with a tail emission of 0.6 XMR per minute forever. Nethxeum has a hard cap of 42 million NTU with no tail emission, following a Bitcoin-style halving schedule. This creates predictable scarcity while maintaining the same privacy features.
faq_was_there_a_premine_or: Was there a premine or ICO?
faq_no_nethxeum_had_a_fair: No. Nethxeum had a fair launch with zero premine and no ICO. Block 0 contained no pre-allocated coins. Every NTU in existence must be earned through proof-of-work mining. No entity — including the founder Rony Katie — holds any special allocation.
faq_how_do_i_mine_nethxeum: How do I mine Nethxeum?
faq_you_can_mine_nethxeum_using: You can mine Nethxeum using any modern CPU with the RandomX algorithm. Download the daemon and use the --start-mining flag, or use a mining pool with XMRig. For optimal performance, enable huge pages and use physical CPU cores rather than hyper-threads. See our Mining Guide for detailed instructions.
faq_what_are_the_system_requirements: What are the system requirements?
faq_minimum_2_cpu_cores_4gb:
Minimum: 2 CPU cores, 4GB RAM, 50GB SSD, Ubuntu 20.04 / Windows 10.
Recommended: 4+ CPU cores, 8GB+ RAM, 200GB NVMe, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS.
For the GUI wallet, you need a modern GPU with OpenGL 3.0+ support.
faq_is_nethxeum_anonymous: Is Nethxeum anonymous?
faq_nethxeum_provides_strong_privacy_gua: Nethxeum provides strong privacy guarantees through cryptographic techniques: ring signatures hide the sender, RingCT hides transaction amounts, and stealth addresses hide the recipient. However, no privacy system is perfect — network-level privacy (IP address) should be protected using Tor or I2P for maximum anonymity.
faq_where_can_i_buy_ntu: Where can I buy NTU?
faq_nethxeum_is_currently_in_its: Nethxeum is currently in its early stages. The best way to acquire NTU is through mining. Exchange listings are planned for Phase 3 of the roadmap (2026). Always be cautious of unofficial exchanges and potential scams.
faq_how_do_i_store_ntu: How do I store NTU safely?
faq_download_the_official_nethxeum_gui: Download the official Nethxeum GUI Wallet or use the CLI wallet. Always back up your 25-word seed mnemonic securely (write it down, never store digitally). Use a strong password and consider running your own full node for maximum privacy. Never share your seed or private keys with anyone.
faq_what_is_the_block_time: What is the block time and reward?
faq_nethxeum_has_a_5_minute: Nethxeum has a 5-minute block time and an initial block reward of 50 NTU. The reward halves every 420,000 blocks (~4 years). There is no tail emission — once the 42 million NTU supply cap is reached, block rewards will be zero.

mine_randomx_is_a_proof_of: RandomX is a proof-of-work algorithm designed to be efficient on general-purpose CPUs while being economically impractical for ASICs and inefficient for GPUs.
mine_it_achieves_this_through_random: It achieves this through random code execution and memory-hard operations tuned to CPU cache sizes. # Install dependencies
sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y build-essential cmake git \ libboost-all-dev libssl-dev libzmq3-dev libpgm-dev \ libunbound-dev libsodium-dev libunwind-dev liblzma-dev \ libreadline-dev libldns-dev libexpat1-dev libgtest-dev

# Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/nethxeum/nethxeum.git
cd nethxeum

# Build
mkdir build && cd build
cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
make -j$(nproc)

# Binaries are in build/bin/
ls build/bin/
# nethxeumd nethxeum-wallet-cli nethxeum-wallet-rpc
user_running_a_full_node: Running a Full Node
user_start_daemon_mainnet_nethxeumd_deta:
# Start daemon (mainnet)
./nethxeumd --detach --log-file=nethxeum.log

# Start daemon (testnet)
./nethxeumd --testnet --detach

# Check sync status
./nethxeumd status

# View logs
tail -f nethxeum.log

# Stop daemon
./nethxeumd exit
user_cli_wallet_create_receive: CLI Wallet — Create & Receive
user_create_new_wallet_nethxeum_wallet:
# Create new wallet
./nethxeum-wallet-cli --generate-new-wallet=my_wallet

# You will be prompted to:
# 1. Set a password
# 2. Confirm seed mnemonic (write this down securely!)

# Show your address
[wallet NTU...]: address

# Check balance
[wallet NTU...]: balance

# Refresh / sync wallet
[wallet NTU...]: refresh
user_2_confirm_seed_mnemonic_write: # 2. Confirm seed mnemonic (write this down securely!)
user_cli_wallet_send_ntu: CLI Wallet — Send NTU
user_basic_transfer_wallet_ntu_transfer:
# Basic transfer
[wallet NTU...]: transfer ADDRESS AMOUNT

# Example: send 10 NTU
[wallet NTU...]: transfer NTUxxx...xxx 10

# Set custom fee priority (1=slow, 2=normal, 3=fast)
[wallet NTU...]: set priority 2

# View transaction history
[wallet NTU...]: show_transfers
vocab_key_terms_and_definitions_for: Key terms and definitions for understanding Nethxeum.
vocab_a_string_of_characters_used: A string of characters used to receive NTU. Starts with "NTU" followed by encoded public keys.
vocab_the_smallest_denomination_of_ntu: The smallest denomination of NTU. 1 NTU = 10^8 atomic units (8 decimal places).
vocab_a_collection_of_transactions_bundl: A collection of transactions bundled together and added to the blockchain approximately every 5 minutes.
vocab_the_distributed_ledger_containing_: The distributed ledger containing all Nethxeum transactions since the genesis block.
vocab_the_background_process_that_mainta: The background process that maintains a copy of the blockchain and handles network communication.
vocab_the_property_that_each_unit: The property that each unit of currency is interchangeable with any other unit. Nethxeum's privacy ensures perfect fungibility.
vocab_the_first_block_in_the: The first block in the Nethxeum blockchain, mined on May 31, 2026. Contains no coinbase reward.
vocab_the_event_where_the_block: The event where the block reward is cut in half, occurring every 420,000 blocks (~4 years).
vocab_a_cryptographi_marker_that_prevent: A cryptographic marker that prevents double-spending while maintaining sender anonymity.
vocab_the_process_of_using_computationa: The process of using computational power (CPU with RandomX) to secure the network and earn block rewards.
vocab_a_computer_running_the_nethxeum: A computer running the Nethxeum daemon that maintains a copy of the blockchain and relays transactions.
vocab_a_cryptographi_technique_used_in: A cryptographic technique used in RingCT to hide transaction amounts while preserving mathematical validity.
vocab_a_cpu_optimized_proof_of: A CPU-optimized proof-of-work algorithm that uses random code execution and memory-hard operations.
vocab_ring_confidential_transactions_hid: Ring Confidential Transactions — hides transaction amounts using cryptographic commitments and range proofs.
vocab_a_cryptographi_signature_that_hide: A cryptographic signature that hides the true signer among a group of possible signers (the "ring").
vocab_a_25_word_phrase_that: A 25-word phrase that encodes your wallet's private keys. Can restore your entire wallet.
vocab_a_one_time_address_generated: A one-time address generated for each transaction that prevents linking payments to a recipient.
vocab_a_private_key_that_allows: A private key that allows viewing incoming transactions without the ability to spend funds.
vocab_the_live_nethxeum_network_where: The live Nethxeum network where real NTU is transacted.
vocab_a_separate_network_for_testing: A separate network for testing with valueless test-NTU.
vocab_a_staging_network_that_mimics: A staging network that mimics mainnet for pre-release testing.
vocab_a_measure_of_how_hard: A measure of how hard it is to find a valid block hash, adjusted to maintain 5-minute block times.
vocab_the_pool_of_unconfirmed_transactio: The pool of unconfirmed transactions waiting to be included in a block.
vocab_when_a_transaction_is_included: When a transaction is included in a block. Nethxeum requires 100 confirmations for mined coins.
what_the_problem_nethxeum_solves: The Problem Nethxeum Solves
what_for_thousands_of_years_physical: For thousands of years, physical cash possessed two fundamental properties: scarcity and confidentiality. The digital revolution dismantled both simultaneously.
what_bitcoinsolve_digital_scarcity_but_l: Bitcoin solved digital scarcity but left transactions fully public. Chain analysis firms trace every movement, and "tainted" coins are rejected by exchanges — violating fungibility.
what_monerosolved_privacy_with_cryptogra: Monero solved privacy with cryptographic elegance but has no supply cap. Its tail emission means predictable scarcity is impossible.
what_nethxeumis_the_synthesis_mathematic: Nethxeum is the synthesis: mathematical scarcity and cryptographic confidentiality. The best of both worlds.
what_the_solution: The Solution
what_nethxeum_ntu_is_a_decentralize: Nethxeum (NTU) is a decentralized, privacy-preserving cryptocurrency combining Bitcoin's proven scarcity model with Monero's battle-tested privacy.
what_hard_supply_cap_42_000: Hard supply cap: 42,000,000 NTU — never one more
what_bitcoin_style_halving_every_420: Bitcoin-style halving: Every 420,000 blocks (~4 years)
what_zero_tail_emission_supply_hard: Zero tail emission: Supply hard stops at 42M
what_full_privacy_ring_signatures_ringct: Full privacy: Ring signatures + RingCT + Stealth addresses
what_cpu_mining_randomx_algorithm_no: CPU mining: RandomX algorithm, no ASICs
what_fair_launch_no_premine_no: Fair launch: No premine, no ICO, no dev tax
what_open_source_mit_licensed_fully: Open source: MIT licensed, fully auditable
what_every_transaction_is_private_by: Every transaction is private by default. No opt-in required. The protocol enforces privacy at every layer.
what_all_transactions_are_opaque_no: All transactions are opaque. No NTU can ever be "tainted". 1 NTU = 1 NTU, always and everywhere.
what_42_000_000_ntu_never: 42,000,000 NTU. Never one more. The halving creates a monetary policy anyone can verify and trust.
what_randomx_ensures_mining_is_efficient: RandomX ensures mining is efficient on any modern CPU. Anyone with a computer can participate.
what_technical_origins: Technical Origins
what_nethxeum_is_a_fork_ofmonero: Nethxeum is a fork of Monero v0.18.3.3, inheriting over a decade of battle-tested privacy cryptography. Rather than reinventing cryptographic primitives, Nethxeum replaces Monero's inflationary emission model with a Bitcoin-style hard cap and halving schedule.
what_the_result_is_a_chain: The result is a chain that maximizes both security (proven privacy technology) and monetary soundness (fixed supply). Every design decision prioritizes:
what_design_philosophy: Design Philosophy
what_nethxeum_exists_because_financial_p: Nethxeum exists because financial privacy is a human right, not a privilege to be granted by states or corporations. The argument that "only criminals need privacy" is historically illiterate and logically incoherent.
what_every_surveillance_system_ever_buil: Every surveillance system ever built has been abused. A doctor does not publish patient records. A business does not publish supply chain negotiations. An individual does not publish their salary. Financial privacy is a prerequisite for human dignity, political freedom, and economic autonomy.
what_nethxeum_privacy_by_default_freedom: "Nethxeum — Privacy by default, freedom by design."
